headline: Growth stalls sharply as costs outpace sales
summary_short: Revenue rose just 3.0% y/y to $715M — a sharp deceleration — while net income fell 28.6% y/y to $64M and operating income dropped 13.0% to $102M as platform-operations costs grew 22.1%, outpacing sales. Adjusted EBITDA margin (company non-GAAP) compressed to 34% from 39% a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue grew only 3.0% y/y to $715M, a sharp deceleration; CEO Jeff Green said the quarter 'did not meet the standard' the company set for itself, citing a complex ad-market environment. Platform-operations costs rose 22.1% y/y to $184M, outpacing revenue and compressing operating income 13.0% to $102M and company non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA margin to 34% from 39%. Net income fell 28.6% y/y to $64M, a steeper decline than pretax income (-15.1%) because the effective tax rate rose to about 43% from 32%. The company repurchased $78M of stock and held $1.12B cash, up $245M q/q on working-capital timing. Q3 2026 guidance calls for revenue of at least $650M and Adjusted EBITDA near $160M, both below Q2's actual levels.

drivers.explanation: CEO Jeff Green said the quarter did not meet the company's own standard, citing a complex environment for marketers and 'decisive action' to strengthen execution — no specific line-item cause given.
Not explained in the release beyond the CEO's general reference to a complex advertising-market environment; no per-channel or per-vertical revenue breakdown was disclosed this quarter.
Operating-margin compression is fully explained by platform-operations costs growing 22.1% y/y to $184M while revenue grew only 3.0% y/y — costs outpaced sales growth this quarter.
Net income fell more than pretax income (-28.6% vs -15.1%) because the effective tax rate rose to about 43% from 32% a year earlier; the release does not explain the tax-rate increase.
